test_title: PYST 71: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 23 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

Trigonometry has been taught by him for donkey's years.

options.text: He had been teaching trigonometry for donkey's years.
He has been trigonometry teaching for donkey's years.
He is teaching trigonometry for donkey's years.
He has taught trigonometry for donkey's years.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Active voice structure: The subject of the passive voice sentence becomes the object of the active voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "Trigonometry has been taught by him for donkey's years.."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the subject "He" at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form "has been taught" to "has taught" (present perfect).
 
• Remove the preposition "by" to make it grammatically correct.
 
• Ensure the time phrase "for donkey's years" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** He has taught trigonometry for donkey's years.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"He had been teaching trigonometry for donkey's years." – Incorrect tense (past perfect continuous).
 
• **Option 2: **"He has been trigonometry teaching for donkey's years." – Incorrect word order.
 
• **Option 3: **"He is teaching trigonometry for donkey's years." – Incorrect tense (present continuous).
